# Cleaning With Purpose

> Senior-friendly home cleaning for older adults and their families across Metro Detroit. A familiar cleaner, agreed priorities, and a visit update. Cleaning and family communication; not medical or personal care.

## Service area
Metro Detroit, Michigan: Detroit, Dearborn, Royal Oak, Ferndale, Southfield, Troy, Warren, Grosse Pointe, Livonia, and surrounding communities.

## Packages
- Purpose Home Reset — the deeper first visit, $225–$375 by home size and condition; includes the first Purpose Note.
- Comfort Clean — recurring senior-friendly cleaning, from $149/visit; includes a visit completion note.
- Peace-of-Mind Visit — recurring cleaning plus the Purpose Note, from $199/visit.
- Purpose Plus — recurring cleaning with expanded focus areas and a more detailed Purpose Note, from $289/visit.

The free 30-minute walkthrough confirms the cleaning scope and exact written quote before booking. Updates go only to agreed recipients. Photos require written permission.
